I told him there is a registry process.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"There is. Sit down, both of you.","sfx_cue":"wooden chair scraped back"},{"speaker":"dhawale","text":"I prefer standing. Possession. Registration at the agreed price of thirty-one lakh.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"You said the land is worth one crore forty lakh.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"dhawale","text":"That is why Friday is important.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"No. Notice must be served. The other party must consent to arbitration.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"dhawale","text":"The agreement contains an arbitration clause.","sfx_cue":"file pages flipped rapidly"},{"speaker":"morris","text":"An arbitration clause is not consent to whichever room you choose.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"dhawale","text":"Then persuade him this is the correct room.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"I do not persuade parties. I hear them.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"dhawale","text":"Of course. Your shop is above rented premises, isn't it? A long dispute with the landlord would be inconvenient.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Sir... should I go outside?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"No. You are the registry clerk. I will merely bring everybody at the useful time.","sfx_cue":"heavy file closed"},{"speaker":"narrator","text":"Friday arrived with two witnesses, one reluctant seller, and an advocate old enough to distrust clean paper.","sfx_cue":"tyre shop air compressor roaring below"},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Case number zero zero three of two thousand twenty-two. Applicant versus respondent. All parties come inside.","sfx_cue":"hand bell shaken twice"},{"speaker":"landowner","text":"This is the court? Above a tyre shop?","sfx_cue":"crowd murmuring in narrow room"},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"Do not answer anything yet. Let me see the board.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"dhawale","text":"You received notice. You came with counsel. Thirty-one lakh is robbery now.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"dhawale","text":"It was not robbery when he took my two lakh.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"landowner","text":"That was a token. I... He admits it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"He admits receiving an offer. He does not admit this forum has jurisdiction.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Your client came after notice. He filed a reply through you. He is arguing the merits.","sfx_cue":"papers tapped into alignment"},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"Appearance is not appointment.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Correct. Sarika, give both parties the consent memorandum.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Sir, the blue copy or the white copy?","sfx_cue":"papers shuffled nervously"},{"speaker":"morris","text":"The white copy. I will give you ten minutes.","sfx_cue":"desk bell struck once"},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"And if we sign, you will hear us fully?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Every document. Every objection. That is not an admission on the merits.","sfx_cue":"paper laid on desk"},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Recorded. Paragraph nine.","sfx_cue":"page turned once"},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"I... let me see that.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"You drafted it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"voice in room","text":"The advocate wrote against his own client.","sfx_cue":"brief scattered laughter"},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"Silence. This is not a tea stall.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"No. It is a hearing. Continue with your objection.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"There is no further factual objection.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Then the hearing is closed.","sfx_cue":"desk bell struck once"},{"speaker":"narrator","text":"For forty minutes, Morris typed the largest order he had ever put beneath his seal.","sfx_cue":"typewriter keys striking steadily"},{"speaker":"morris","text":"The respondent shall accept the balance of twenty-nine lakh and execute the conveyance within seven days.","sfx_cue":"room silent under tyre shop rumble"},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Until registration, the respondent shall create no third-party interest in the land.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"landowner","text":"And if I refuse?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Your signed consent and this award will accompany the applicant's enforcement petition.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"dhawale","text":"I have the banker's cheque here.","sfx_cue":"cheque torn from booklet"},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"Give it to me. My client will acknowledge receipt.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"landowner","text":"You are telling me to obey him? In front of everyone?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"I am telling you that you signed the agreement, accepted arbitration, and lost on the documents.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"landowner","text":"Then write that I am taking the cheque under the award.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"I will record it, sir.","sfx_cue":"registry stamp pressed firmly"},{"speaker":"advocate","text":"Record this also. My client will execute the conveyance within seven days.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"dhawale","text":"Thank you, sir. I asked for the order that placed you here before today.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"dhawale","text":"Counsel, your client accepted the award. Two people are waiting outside.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Send them away.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"They paid the filing fee.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Refund it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"sarika","text":"Sir, did they do something wrong?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Their dispute is already in district court.
